reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Patient-paired multiomic treatment-associated program discovery, assay-specific preprocessing, primary late integration/enrichment and locked external cohort validation.

checks.reason: No explicit pre-execution plan to consult original assay Methods, supplements or validated analysis protocols and check their transfer to the present inputs.

checks.quote: transformations and normalization appropriate to their actual measurement scales
checks.reason: No specified conditional normalization/transformation algorithm or concrete procedure selecting it from identified platform inputs. The ordered workflow is useful but is not computationally executable.
Controls are named, but no explicit false-rejection/precision/dynamic-range criterion or procedure mapping reference measurements to a calibrated pass threshold and response.

Patient independence and resampling are correct; no pilot/technical variance-to-detectable-effect or confidence-width calculation establishes what 30 patients and the small external cohort can resolve.

No chosen primary test/interval procedure or operational multiplicity method/family is given. An illustrative regression and generic uncertainty/error-control instructions leave the inferential implementation unresolved.

checks.quote: Calibrate feature count, shrinkage and weighting
checks.reason: No bounded grid or derivation of search limits and search stop; internal resampling alone does not define the parameter exploration.
No immutable input hashes and exact dependency/environment/command manifest sufficient to reconstruct the computation.
No clean-environment numerical rerun, output tolerances or runtime/resource/failure logs; no reproducible figure-table specification or source-difference audit.
